verdict.rationale: Datadog's Monitors docs [datadog-docs-10] point to user-defined alert rules that fire when conditions are met on metrics, logs, and other events, which covers the core rule-triggers-on-event idea. Incident Management [datadog-docs-14] suggests downstream response handling. However, the evidence consists of page titles only, and nothing shows rules triggering arbitrary automated actions beyond alerting. Missing for 10: evidence of a workflow/action automation engine (e.g., auto-remediation or chained actions), detail on what actions monitors can trigger beyond notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
